failure: The actual Manager aggregation never released before the fixed HttpClient timeout, despite successful bounded StepExecution decoding for all replies.
rootCause: CPF dynamically materializes RemotePartitioningManagerStepBuilder after context refresh without supplying BeanFactory. The official Spring Batch 6.0.4 builder therefore registers no aggregation flow; its late-registration path is also autoStartup(false) and requires CPF-owned lifecycle start/cleanup.
